data.one_liner: Renders mathematical and chemical equations using LaTeX, TeX, MathML, and AsciiMath.
data.what_it_does: Flutter TeX is a self-contained package leveraging MathJax to provide fully offline rendering of mathematical, physics, chemistry, and statistics equations. It supplies widgets like Math2SVG, TeXWidget, and TeXView to support various formatting needs.
use_when: You need to render complex mathematical or scientific equations in your Flutter application.
You require offline rendering support for LaTeX, MathML, or AsciiMath.
avoid_when: You only need to display plain text without any mathematical or scientific notation.
strengths: Supports multiple formats including LaTeX, TeX, MathML, and AsciiMath.
Offers multiple specialized widgets like Math2SVG, TeXWidget, and TeXView.
weaknesses: Requires following platform-specific installation guides before running.
Relies on webview or complex SVG rendering under the hood.
data.setup_notes: Requires following the detailed Installation Guide for different platforms before running examples and setup configurations.
